title: W2+PMW Weather EAS
description: This mod adds some blocks and items so you can report storms, also cleaner version of my old mod Advanced EAS.
body:
This mod is basically just an EAS tool for both Weather2 and Protomanly's weather.

It adds handheld phone to report weather, a router block for your house, and a radio tower block to put nearby your town or village!

Works on servers and singleplayer!
Have fun trying the mod out!
